
# Data file format
This folder contains example georeferenced geochemical data from Prow-Fleischer et al (in prep) used for overlaying localities in map view and for statisticical analysis. 

Prefered .txt or .csv tab delimited. The proxy doesn't matter. Just that the value can be compared to a tracer in cGenie (e.g., d18Oap must be converted to a SST)

Header should look like this
Paleolong	paleoLat 	proxy_value	site_label
